# `clear_autosave_err`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Clear the stored capture error, or the last error of the current enabled legacy-plan target.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xdfa50, ClearCurrentTargetErr @0x3078b0 (64-bit build) |

Without an object params the device clears its global capture error code and sets the error-changed flag. With an object params carrying plan_last true it clears the last error of the current enabled target of the legacy (set_plan) plan store, if there is one; a missing current target is not an error. An object without a true plan_last is rejected.

Side effects: Resets the global capture error code and its flag, or the last-error field of the current enabled legacy-plan target, which users see as the autosave or capture error. Takes the relevant lock. No explicit timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"clear_autosave_err"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Two forms. (1) Params absent or any non-object (null, scalar, array): clears the global capture error. (2) Object: plan_last MUST be present and true (boolean true, or a nonzero integer) and clears the last error of the current enabled legacy-plan target. An object without a true plan_last is rejected with 106. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 106 | Object params whose plan_last is absent, null, of the wrong type, false or 0 | `expected bool param` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

The result of the target-error clear is ignored, so a missing current target still replies with success.

## Example

Request, request - Clear the capture error:

```json
{"id":40,"method":"clear_autosave_err"}
```

Request, plan-last - Clear the current plan target's last error:

```json
{"id":41,"method":"clear_autosave_err","params":{"plan_last":true}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"method":"clear_autosave_err","result":0,"code":0,"id":40}
```

Reply, plan-last-false:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"clear_autosave_err","error":"expected bool param","code":106,"id":42}
```
